FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)
(SEREMBAN-PORT DICKSON EXPRESSWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2016

IN exerc ise of the powers conferred by s ection 2 of the
Federal Roads (Private Management) Act 1984 [ Act 306 ], the Minister makes
the following order:

Citation and commencement
1.        (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)
(Collection of Tolls) ( Seremban-Port Dickso n Expressway) (Amendment)
Order 2016.

 (2) This Order is deemed to have come into operation on 12 January 2012.

Amendment of paragraph 2
2.  The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)
(Seremban-Port Dickson Expressway) Order 2004 [ P.U. (A) 326/2004 ], which is
referred to as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in  subparagraph 2(1)—

(a) by substituting for the words "Projek Lebuh Raya Utara-Selatan Berhad"
the words "Projek Lebuh Raya Usahasama Berhad";

(b) by substituting for the words "1 January 2005 t o 31 May 2030" the words
"12 January 2012 to 31 May 2038";

(c) by substituting for the words "column (2) of Part I and II of the
First Schedule according to the concession years as specified in
column (1) of Part I and II of the First Schedule" the  words "column (2) of
the First Schedule"; and

(d) by substituting for the words " column (2) of Part I and II" the words
"column (1)".

Substitution of First Schedule
3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for the First Schedule the
following Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[Subparagraph 2(1)]

RATES OF TOLL FOR THE PERIOD FROM 12 JANUARY 2012 UNTIL 31 DECEMBER 2016

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and
wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and
wheels of the vehicle.".

Made 11 May 2016
[KKR.PUU. 110-1/7/1 Jld.17 (38); PN(PU2)426/LX]
